## Wave 4 → (session close) Decision Point

This is the terminal wave (no Wave 5 consumes it). Branch on the gate verdict:

- **PRE-REG-INC** (canonical likely outcome — DR3 not yet public): record in the WP §"Wave 4 Synthesis" that the S66-era four-sub-rule decision is **armed** (frozen thresholds + frozen SHAs L1/L2/L3/L4) and **blocked-pending-DESI-DR3-release**. Carry forward to the next session as a **standing live-watch** (the DR3 release-trigger), NOT a compute carry-forward — the only "input" is the external data release. The falsifier-master-inventory Row #1 (w_0) + the w_a row record "armed; DR3 horizon ~2027." No σ-distance re-emission. **No padding** (`feedback_fix-in-session-never-defer.md`): the live-watch is a data-availability watch, not a 4-field compute spec.
- **PASS / FAIL / INFO** (Track B — DR3 released): land the verdict on the `mack-cosmic-bridge` sole-writer surfaces — `falsifier-master-inventory.md` Row #1 + w_a row, atlas-04 §IX DESI cells, capstone §7 falsifier-anchor row — per the canonical write-order (`math-scripts.md §"Canonical Write-Order"`: verdict file → canonical_constants (only if a NEW prediction value is produced — here NONE is, the rule FIRES the existing w0_FW/wa_FW) → inventory row). **If L4 reversal fired** (w_0^{DR3} ∈ [-0.86,-0.83]): route the `w0_FW = -0.918 → -0.842454` canonical-constants re-emission + the Row #1 σ-distance recomputation to a FOLLOW-UP session per `w0-primary-decision-rule.md` §6 (a 4-stage re-pin, NOT an in-gate edit). The capstone-hygiene 5-question gate fires (Q2 §7 falsifier-row touched; Q3 status change) — route the §7 cell update to mack (sole writer) and the §-prose to the capstone designated writer (reviewed patch, no bulk append).
